verdict.rationale: ADK explicitly documents a Tool Confirmation flow (HITL) that pauses tool execution for explicit human confirmation/custom input, plus a Workflow Runtime and Task API that both list human-in-the-loop as a supported pattern for pausing/resuming agent flows. However, there's no detailed first-party walkthrough or independent corroboration showing the full pause-mid-run-and-resume-with-decision mechanics in depth. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end example/tutorial of pausing and resuming with human decision, independent/hands-on verification of this workflow.
